tagline: Kenya. Wild. Alive. — From the Savannah to the Ocean
about: Utamaduni Safaris was born in Kombani, a small town in Kwale County, from the friendship of two young men who grew up surrounded by Kenya's most incredible natural wonders. Salim and Abdallah saw the beauty of Shimba Hills, the magic of the coast, and the richness of Swahili culture — and decided the world needed to experience it too.
address: Kombani, Matuga Sub-County, Kwale County, Kenya

destinations.title: Shimba Hills National Reserve
destinations.short: Coastal rainforest, elephants & Kenya's only sable antelope.
destinations.description: Just inland from the coast, Shimba Hills protects one of East Africa's last large coastal rainforests. Home to elephants, the rare sable antelope, and the beautiful Sheldrick Falls.

destinations.title: Diani & Tiwi Beaches
destinations.short: Powder-white sands and turquoise Indian Ocean waters.
destinations.description: Diani Beach is repeatedly voted among Africa's best. Long stretches of soft sand, calm lagoons, kitesurfing, and relaxed Swahili coastal life.

destinations.title: Kisite-Mpunguti Marine Park
destinations.short: Dolphins, coral reefs and dhow sailing to Wasini Island.
destinations.description: Kenya's premier marine park. Snorkel vibrant reefs, swim with dolphins, sail traditional dhows and enjoy fresh seafood on car-free Wasini Island.

destinations.title: Kaya Forests & Culture
destinations.short: Sacred Mijikenda forests and living coastal heritage.
destinations.description: Guided walks into sacred kaya forests with community elders. Learn about traditional beliefs, conservation practices, local dances and Swahili coastal cuisine.

destinations.title: Maasai Mara National Reserve
destinations.short: The Great Migration and Africa's most iconic safari destination.
destinations.description: The Maasai Mara is Kenya's most celebrated reserve, home to the annual wildebeest migration, the Big Five, and spectacular open savannah landscapes that define the African safari experience.

destinations.title: Amboseli National Park
destinations.short: Elephants against the backdrop of mighty Mount Kilimanjaro.
destinations.description: Amboseli offers some of Africa's most iconic views — massive elephant herds roaming freely beneath the snow-capped peak of Mount Kilimanjaro. A photographer's paradise.

destinations.title: Tsavo East & West
destinations.short: Kenya's largest park — red elephants, lava flows and vast wilderness.
destinations.description: Tsavo is Kenya's largest national park system, divided into Tsavo East and West. Famous for its red-dusted elephants, the Mzima Springs, Lugard Falls, and incredible biodiversity.

destinations.title: Mount Kenya
destinations.short: Africa's second-highest peak — trekking, glaciers and unique alpine wildlife.
destinations.description: Mount Kenya offers dramatic trekking routes through bamboo forests, moorlands and glaciated peaks. The surrounding national park is home to buffalo, leopard, and rare mountain bongo.

destinations.title: Lake Nakuru National Park
destinations.short: Flamingos, rhinos and a lake that turns pink.
destinations.description: Lake Nakuru is famous for its stunning flamingo flocks that colour the water pink. The park is also one of Kenya's most reliable places to spot both black and white rhinos.

destinations.title: Samburu National Reserve
destinations.short: Rare northern species in a dramatic semi-arid landscape.
destinations.description: Samburu is home to species found nowhere else in Kenya — the Grevy's zebra, reticulated giraffe, Somali ostrich, Beisa oryx and the gerenuk. Set in a stunning semi-arid landscape along the Ewaso Ng'iro River.

destinations.title: Hell's Gate National Park
destinations.short: Cycle through gorges, geysers and dramatic cliffs — no car needed.
destinations.description: Hell's Gate is Kenya's most unique park — you can cycle or hike through it. Dramatic volcanic cliffs, Ol Njorowa Gorge, Fischer's Tower, and natural geothermal geysers make it unforgettable.

destinations.title: Lamu Island
destinations.short: UNESCO-listed Swahili city, dhow sailing and pristine beaches.
destinations.description: Lamu Old Town is a UNESCO World Heritage Site — Kenya's oldest living Swahili settlement. No cars, just donkeys and dhows. Stunning beaches, fresh seafood and a timeless coastal atmosphere.

destinations.title: Watamu Marine Park
destinations.short: Sea turtles, world-class diving and pristine coral reefs.
destinations.description: Watamu is a marine biodiversity hotspot. The marine national park protects nesting sea turtles, vibrant coral gardens, tropical fish, and offers some of East Africa's best snorkelling and diving.

destinations.title: Malindi
destinations.short: Historic Swahili coast town with beaches, heritage and marine life.
destinations.description: Malindi blends Portuguese colonial history with Swahili coastal culture. Visit the Vasco da Gama pillar, explore the marine park, enjoy the nightlife, or simply relax on wide sandy beaches.

adventures.title: Shimba Hills Safari Day
adventures.description: Game drive + forest walk + Sheldrick Falls. Picnic lunch included.

adventures.title: Dhow & Dolphin Experience
adventures.description: Boat to Kisite, snorkelling, dolphin spotting, Wasini seafood lunch.

adventures.title: Cultural Kaya Immersion
adventures.description: Guided sacred forest walk with elders + traditional performance.

adventures.title: Mwaluganje Elephant Sanctuary
adventures.description: Community conservancy focused on elephants and local livelihoods.

adventures.title: Coastal Free Day Package
adventures.description: Beach transfer, optional kitesurf intro or colobus conservation visit.

adventures.title: Multi-day Utamaduni Circuit
adventures.description: Custom mix of wildlife, marine and cultural days with accommodation options.

adventures.title: Maasai Mara Migration Safari
adventures.description: Fly-in or drive to the Mara for the greatest wildlife show on Earth. Game drives, Big Five, Maasai village visit.

adventures.title: Amboseli Elephants & Kilimanjaro
adventures.description: Photograph elephant families with Mount Kilimanjaro as the backdrop. Unforgettable.

adventures.title: Lamu Island Cultural Retreat
adventures.description: Dhow cruise, old town walking tour, beach relaxation and fresh seafood on Lamu Island.

adventures.title: Hell's Gate Cycling Adventure
adventures.description: Cycle through dramatic gorges and geothermal features. Great for adventurous travelers.
